findings: 300-Ki Other Super restricted to Majin CaCs. The user falls asleep to recover Health; the user is vulnerable and cannot move or use an Evasive while sleeping, and releasing input ends the sleep after the wake-up sequence. In Purification, the skill also restores Ki and Stamina. Exact recovery rate and timing remain unresolved.
evidence_boundaries: Source-reported numerical values remain bounded evidence.
Unsupported exact frames, hidden gates, probabilities, and patch-independent scaling are not promoted.
